description: Defines utility functions related to networking, such as checking network interface existence, generating MAC and IP addresses, and converting them to strings within the cuttlefish namespace.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaceExists
methods.description: Checks if a network interface with the specified name exists.

methods.name: TapInterfacesInUse
methods.description: Returns a set of TAP device names that currently have open file descriptors (Linux only).

methods.name: GenerateCorrespondingIpv6ForMac
methods.description: Generates an IPv6 address based on a MAC address.

methods.name: GenerateMobileMacForInstance
methods.description: Generates a MAC address for a mobile network interface instance.

methods.name: GenerateEthMacForInstance
methods.description: Generates an Ethernet MAC address for a specific instance.

methods.name: GenerateWifiMacForInstance
methods.description: Generates a Wi-Fi MAC address for a specific instance.

methods.name: MacAddressToString
methods.description: Converts a MAC address to its string representation.

methods.name: Ipv6ToString
methods.description: Converts an IPv6 address to its string representation.
